top_signals.title: MARA swings to Q2 loss as Bitcoin’s slump masks higher output
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin miner MARA posted its highest quarterly Bitcoin production in over a year, but was overshadowed by a 28% decline in the average price of Bitcoin.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Meta ordered to pay U.S. state $567 million over ‘public nuisance’ and child harm
top_signals.summary: Around three-quarters of the new $567 million fund is set to be used for mental health treatment, with the funds to be paid over five years.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
